title: Intermittent API 500 errors
body:
Getting frequent 500 Internal Server Error responses from the API during normal Claude Code CLI usage.

**Error:**
```
API Error: 500
{"type":"error","error":{"type":"api_error","message":"Internal server error"},"request_id":"req_011CYV9PEemMn6GuoiB6xUps"}
```

**Environment:**
- Claude Code CLI
- Linux (Ubuntu/Pop!_OS)
- Model: claude-opus-4-6

The errors are intermittent and disrupt workflow. No changes on the client side — appears to be a server-side issue.
author: dnickerson
